description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of difficulty levels for a set of knowledge crosswords, categorized as easy, medium, and hard, along with performance metrics denoted as N-K+, N-K-, N+K-, and Short-Shot. The chart contains six slices in total. The “easy” category is teal and represents 55.4% of the chart, while “medium” is a lighter green and accounts for 58.8%. The “hard” category is colored orange and occupies 35.4% of the chart. The remaining three slices represent performance metrics: N-K+ is colored yellow and comprises 18.1%, N-K- is red and represents 6.7%, and N+K- is a darker red and accounts for 4.8%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices do not appear to be ordered in any particular way. A legend is not present, but each slice is labeled directly on the chart.
